decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - At 1 metre outside the windows of any neighbouring habitable room the level of noise from all plant and machinery shall be at all times at least 5 decibels below the existing background noise levels, expressed in dB(A) at such locations. Where the noise from the plant and machinery is tonal in character the differences in these levels shall be at least 10 dB(A).

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the [adjoining] premises [and the area generally] in accordance with the requirements of policy[ies] RE2[, EN5, EN6 and DS6] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 2 - The extract ventilating system shall be provided with acoustic isolation to prevent the transmission of noise and or vibration to any other parts of the building and adjoining premises.

Condition : 3 - The discharge point for the mechanical extract ventilation
    or outlet shall discharged vertically at sufficient height
    above the eaves of the building, 1 metre at least, so as not
    to create a nuisance from fumes and odours to occupiers of
    adjacent premises.   The system shall be fitted with a
    suitable filter unit, and cowls should not be fitted at the
    top of the duct as they deflect fumes downwards.  There
    should be sufficient efflux velocity to ensure adequate
    dispersal of fumes/odours.

Condition : 4 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1 and EN13 [and EN31 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 5 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.

Condition : 6 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.

Condition : 7 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.

Condition : 8 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 9 - You are requested to ensure that no music shall be played on
    the premises in such a way as to be audible within any
    adjoining residential accommodation.

Condition : 10 - A secondary door and lobby shall be provided, and retained
    permanently, behind the new customer entrance doors at the
    Shelton Street/Neal Street junction.

Condition : 11 - So that the Council may be satisfied that the amount of
    noise disturbance to residential neighbours is minimised.

Condition : 12 - Bottles shall not be disposed of outside the building
    between the hours of 23.00 and 08.00.

Condition : 13 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.
description:
Alterations to the ground floor entrance door of the
existing public house on the corner of Neal Street and
Shelton Street, the erection of an enlarged first floor side
extension and the provision of air conditioning and
ventilation equipment in connection with the reorganisation
of the ancillary Class A3 space on the upper floors of the
public house to form a pub dining room and ladies' toilets
on the first floor, a new catering kitchen on the second
floor and reorganisation of the ancillary residential
accommodation on the second and third floors to form two
separate one-bedroom flats ancillary to the use of the
premises for purposes within Class A3,
as shown on drawing numbers 1591/1C, 2, 3A and 4B.
